source: Published SDK and MCP capability inventories
scope: Public callable names; not credentials, private records, deployment configuration, or proof authority.
execution: SDK exports and client methods are separate from MCP tools. An inventory entry does not grant access or create an MCP adapter. Each operation retains its proof, consent, custody, scope, and environment requirements.
